rule.name: sudden_spending_new_account
rule.description: Detects recently opened accounts with sudden, large spending.

rule.name: synthetic_identity_gift_cards

rule.rationale: New accounts with high-value transactions in specific categories are likely synthetic identities.

rule.name: international_pos_impossible_travel
rule.description: Detects transactions where a card is used in person in a foreign country shortly after being used at home.
rule.rationale: This rule identifies transactions that are physically impossible given the travel time between home and foreign countries, indicating potential fraud.

rule.name: international_atm_cashing_out
rule.description: Detects skimmed cards being cashed out at ATMs abroad with transactions in more than one country on the same day.

rule.name: unusual_velocity

rule.rationale: This rule identifies cards that have a high number of transactions and a large total amount within a 24-hour period, which is indicative of unusual velocity and potential fraud.

rule.name: low_credit_high_chargebacks

rule.rationale: Customers with low credit scores and a history of chargebacks are at higher risk of fraudulent activity.

rule.name: nightly_crypto_gambling
